errors.missingKey: No API key is saved for the current model yet. Open Settings → Model & Provider to add your key, or switch to a local Ollama / LM Studio model.

errors.quota: This API account has insufficient balance or reached its quota limit. Please check your provider billing.

errors.modelNotFound: The configured model was not found on this provider. Please choose a valid model ID in Settings.

errors.network: Could not reach the model provider. Check your internet connection, Base URL, or make sure your local Ollama / LM Studio server is running.
errors.unknown: The AI request could not be completed. Please try again or check Settings.
